request: how much do you earn for 45 hours if overtime after 40 hours is paid at time and a half of £12?

beats.intent: A bar of 40 normal hours at £12 an hour
beats.narration: You're paid twelve pounds an hour for the first forty hours of the week.
beats.code:
stage.title("Pay with overtime")
k = 0.12
x0 = -6
normal = Rectangle(width=40 * k, height=0.6, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.5).move_to([x0 + 20 * k, 1.4, 0])
stage.play(GrowFromEdge(normal, LEFT))
stage.add(normal)
stage.play(FadeIn(Text("40 h × £12", font_size=26).move_to(normal)))

beats.intent: Five more hours in orange, each paid £12 × 1.5 = £18
beats.narration: You work five more hours. Overtime is time and a half: twelve pounds plus half of twelve, eighteen pounds an hour.
beats.code:
extra = Rectangle(width=5 * k, height=0.6, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.6).next_to(normal, RIGHT, buff=0)
stage.play(GrowFromEdge(extra, LEFT))
stage.add(extra)
stage.label(extra, "5 h × £18", direction=UP, color=ORANGE)

beats.intent: Pay bars underneath: £480 for the normal hours and £90 for overtime, £570 in all
beats.narration: In money: forty times twelve is four hundred and eighty pounds, and five times eighteen is ninety.
beats.code:
m = 0.01
pay1 = Rectangle(width=480 * m, height=0.6, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to([x0 + 240 * m, 0.0, 0])
pay2 = Rectangle(width=90 * m, height=0.6, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.8).next_to(pay1, RIGHT, buff=0)
stage.play(GrowFromEdge(pay1, LEFT))
stage.play(GrowFromEdge(pay2, LEFT))
stage.add(pay1, pay2)
stage.play(FadeIn(Text("£480", font_size=26).move_to(pay1)), FadeIn(Text("£90", font_size=22).move_to(pay2)))
stage.label(VGroup(pay1, pay2), "£570", direction=DOWN, color=GREEN)

beats.narration: Four hundred and eighty plus ninety: five hundred and seventy pounds for the week.

request: how much fuel does a 350 km trip need if the car uses 6 litres per 100 km?

beats.intent: A 350 km route as a line from home to the destination
beats.narration: A trip of three hundred and fifty kilometres.
beats.code:
stage.title("Fuel for a trip")
route = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 350, 50], length=10.5, include_numbers=True, font_size=22).move_to([0, 0.8, 0])
stage.play(Create(route))
stage.add(route)
stage.label(route, "km", direction=RIGHT)

beats.intent: Each 100 km stretch bracketed with a 6 L fuel can, and a half stretch with 3 L
beats.narration: The car uses six litres for every hundred kilometres: three full stretches, and half a stretch at the end.
beats.code:
cans = VGroup()
for a, b, lab in ((0, 100, "6 L"), (100, 200, "6 L"), (200, 300, "6 L"), (300, 350, "3 L")):
    seg = Line(route.n2p(a), route.n2p(b), color=ORANGE if b - a == 100 else YELLOW, stroke_width=8).shift(0.5 * DOWN)
    can = Text(lab, font_size=26, color=seg.get_color()).next_to(seg, DOWN, buff=0.15)
    cans.add(seg, can)
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(m) for m in cans], lag_ratio=0.15))
stage.add(cans)

beats.intent: A fuel gauge bar filling to 21 litres
beats.narration: Add them up: six, twelve, eighteen, and three more, twenty one litres.
beats.code:
tank = Rectangle(width=21 * 0.2, height=0.5, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.6).move_to([-5.3 + 2.1, -1.8, 0])
stage.play(GrowFromEdge(tank, LEFT))
stage.add(tank)
stage.label(tank, "21 litres", direction=RIGHT, color=ORANGE)

beats.narration: Three and a half lots of six is twenty one litres. At one pound fifty a litre, the fuel costs thirty one pounds fifty.

request: if a dart lands at a random spot on a square board, what's the chance it hits the circle in the middle?

beats.intent: A 4 by 4 square board with a circle of radius 1 in the middle
beats.narration: A square board four units wide has a circle of radius one in the middle. A dart lands anywhere on the board, every spot equally likely.
beats.code:
stage.title("Darts and area")
s = 0.85
c = np.array([-3, -0.3, 0])
board = Square(4 * s, color=WHITE).move_to(c)
bull = Circle(radius=s, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.2).move_to(c)
stage.play(Create(board), Create(bull))
stage.add(board, bull)
lb = stage.label(board, "4 × 4", direction=DOWN)
lr = stage.label(bull, "r = 1", direction=UP, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: 200 random darts: those inside the circle yellow, the rest grey, with a count
beats.narration: Throw two hundred darts at random. Only some land in the circle: about one in five.
beats.code:
stage.play(FadeOut(lr))
rng = np.random.default_rng(26)
pts = rng.uniform(-2, 2, size=(200, 2))
inside = (pts ** 2).sum(axis=1) < 1
darts = VGroup(*[Dot(c + s * np.array([x, y, 0]), radius=0.04, color=YELLOW if hit else GREY_B) for (x, y), hit in zip(pts, inside)])
stage.play(FadeIn(darts, lag_ratio=0.01), run_time=1.5)
stage.add(darts)
stage.label(board, f"{int(inside.sum())} of 200 hit", direction=RIGHT, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: The circle's area π compared with the square's area 16
beats.narration: The chance is just the fraction of the board the circle covers: its area, pi, out of the square's sixteen.
beats.code:
stage.play(bull.animate.set_fill(YELLOW, opacity=0.5))
stage.play(FadeOut(lb))
stage.label(board, "circle π ≈ 3.14 of square 16", direction=DOWN, color=YELLOW)

beats.narration: Pi over sixteen is about nought point one nine six, close to the darts' one in five.

request: if today is Monday, what day is it in 100 days?

beats.intent: The seven days of the week round a circle, Monday highlighted
beats.narration: Today is Monday. Put the seven days round a circle.
beats.code:
stage.title("100 days from Monday")
c = np.array([-3, -0.3, 0])
names = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]
pos = [c + 2.0 * np.array([np.cos(PI / 2 - k * TAU / 7), np.sin(PI / 2 - k * TAU / 7), 0]) for k in range(7)]
days = VGroup(*[Text(n, font_size=28).move_to(p) for n, p in zip(names, pos)])
ring = Circle(radius=2.0, color=GREY_B).move_to(c)
stage.play(Create(ring), FadeIn(days))
stage.add(ring, days)
mon = Circle(radius=0.42, color=YELLOW).move_to(pos[0])
stage.play(Create(mon))
stage.add(mon)

beats.intent: A loop arrow round the circle marked × 14: 98 days brings you back to Monday
beats.narration: Every seven days you come back to Monday. Fourteen weeks is ninety eight days: back to Monday again.
beats.code:
stage.play(ring.animate.set_stroke(BLUE, width=6))
stage.play(FadeIn(Text("14 laps = 98 days", font_size=26, color=BLUE).move_to(c)))

beats.intent: Two more steps from Monday to Wednesday, highlighted
beats.narration: That leaves two more days: Tuesday, then Wednesday.
beats.code:
tue = Circle(radius=0.42, color=GREEN_B).move_to(pos[1])
stage.play(Create(tue))
stage.add(tue)
wed = Circle(radius=0.42, color=GREEN).move_to(pos[2])
stage.play(Create(wed))
stage.add(wed)
stage.label(wed, "Wednesday", direction=RIGHT, color=GREEN)

beats.intent: The circle beside 100 = 14 × 7 + 2, so 2 days on from Monday
beats.narration: Only the remainder after dividing by seven matters: a hundred is fourteen sevens and two, so it's Wednesday.
